metaTitle: Custom Blue Golf Tees | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom blue golf tees in bulk for your next event or tournament. Perfect Imprints offers fast turnaround and free artwork.
introHtml: Blue golf tees stand out on the green, making your brand visible from the tee box to the fairway. Whether you're sponsoring a charity tournament or outfitting a corporate outing, custom-imprinted blue tees in 2.75" or 3.25" lengths pair well with matching ball markers or towels. Choose from bio-composite or classic wood options to match your sustainability goals. Our imprint methods ensure crisp logos that survive a full round.
heroAltText: Custom blue golf tees with white logo imprint arranged on a green putting surface
